Minbox text archive

Terms of use

Last updated October 13, 2026 for owner-managed Android/Linux installations and the fixture-tested Mac/iPhone adapter. Live Mac/iPhone acceptance remains unverified.

Authorized use

Use Minbox only with accounts and devices you are authorized to access. Each owner completes their own Google consent and messaging setup. Do not use it to collect another person's account without their authorization.

What the service provides

Minbox collects accessible messaging history, filters excluded content and maintains a private Google Drive archive. Availability depends on device synchronization, permissions, account authorization, network access and the providers involved.

It is not a complete phone backup. Available original images can be stored privately with source links and optional local OCR. Unavailable or unsupported attachments, unavailable history and inaccessible video transcripts may be missing. Keep independent backups if you need recovery protection.

AI answers

Collection and full-archive publication do not require an AI model. You manage any AI service connection yourself, with separate permissions and an optional explained retrieval check. Optional work analysis sends selected eligible content to the configured provider.

AI services can misinterpret messages or omit context. Check original sources before making decisions. A citation or status message does not guarantee that an answer is accurate or that all history has been captured.

Account access and updates

You can stop background jobs and revoke Google access. Revocation does not erase stored archives; manage local and Drive copies separately. Application updates require review and installation and may require new permissions or dependencies.

Health notifications

Optional external email is limited to unresolved emergencies requiring human action. Routine failures, reminders and recovery do not send mail. A local monitor cannot notify during complete host or network failure.

Other services

Google, Apple, Loom, GitHub, hosting providers and any AI services you choose have their own terms and privacy policies. Minbox does not promise their availability or control how they operate.

Questions

Contact spencer.r.h@gmail.com. Review the privacy policy before authorizing an installation.
